# Sim-to-real — trained on Kaal, tested zero-shot on RCAEval (RP-24)

## How to read this

- On Kaal's own test splits, the same ranker scores about 0.998 ([katyayani-kaal.md](katyayani-kaal.md)). The difference between that and this table is the simulation-to-real gap, which is RP-24's real result.
- Online Boutique graph: 9 of 9 traced edges are in the authored graph (case `re2ob_checkoutservice_cpu_1`); 7 authored edges were not seen in that trace.
- Sock Shop graph: not checked: RCAEval has no traces for this system.
- A wrong edge hurts the zero-shot ranker and not the baselines.
- Katyayani trained on RCAEval itself is the reference: [sati-rca.md](sati-rca.md), leave one system out.
